metadata.title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space

metadata.synopsis: Local veterinarian Rack Hansen (William Shatner) and the sleepy little town of Verde Valley soon find themselves right in the center of an eight-legged nightmare when thousands of tarantulas suddenly mutate... and are on the hunt for food!
metadata.title: Kingdom Of The Spiders

metadata.synopsis: In this creature feature, vacationers on an isolated island find themselves at the mercy of voracious ants that have become giant mutants after feasting on a leaking barrels of radioactive waste. From a story by H.G. Wells. Joan Collins stars.
metadata.title: Empire Of The Ants

metadata.synopsis: Half Man, Half Bat, All Terror! After being attacked by a bat, Dr. John Beck mutates into a blood-sucking monster, embarking on a killing spree...and he won't stop until he has the one thing his new existence is missing ... his beautiful wife!
metadata.title: The Bat People

metadata.synopsis: It's the horrifying and hilarious ride into the darkest regions of hell that started it all! When Jonathan (Peter Liapis) inherits his late father's home and finds a book of spells, he unlocks unimaginable demonic horrors!
metadata.title: Ghoulies
